selected_evidence.requirement: node1 routes between lan-a and lan-b
selected_evidence.summary: node1's vtnet1/vtnet2 configured as opt1(lan-a)/opt2(lan-b); node2 (lan-a) and node3 (lan-b) both reach node1's respective LAN IP, and node2 successfully pings node3's lan-b address (10.60.2.2) via node1, proving cross-network routing.

selected_evidence.requirement: Refuse TCP port 23 between lan-a and lan-b
selected_evidence.summary: pf block rules for tcp/23 installed on both opt1 and opt2 ahead of the general pass rules; nc to port 23 times out in both directions (node2->node3 and node3->node2) while tcp/22 (ssh) between the same hosts succeeds, confirming only telnet is refused.

selected_evidence.requirement: Record every refused attempt in a log on node1
selected_evidence.summary: OPNsense's pf filter log (read via read_log.py) captured each blocked tcp/23 SYN with action=block and the rule's descriptive label; entries were extracted into a persistent file /root/telnet_block.log on node1 (root filesystem is UFS, unlike tmpfs /var/log), and the file still contains the refusal records after node1's own reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Show a log entry produced by an attempt made from node2
selected_evidence.summary: Log entries show '2026-09-05T17:59:38 vtnet1 block 10.60.1.2 -> 10.60.2.2:23 antrieb: block+log telnet lan-a to lan-b' and a matching post-reboot entry at 18:00:58 -- 10.60.1.2 is node2's lan-a address, confirming the attempt originated from node2.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime=17:53:52 captured; configctl system reboot dispatched in background (ack returned); SSH timed out during reboot then succeeded again; new kern.boottime=18:00:30 proves an actual restart; post-restart pf rules/interfaces intact and a fresh tcp/23 block from node2 was logged, proving service recovery.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=92ec88af...; reboot dispatched in background (ack returned before disconnect); post-restart boot_id=95b30093... proves restart; lan-a IP reapplied and ping to node1's lan-a gateway succeeded, proving connectivity recovered.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=242af11e...; reboot dispatched in background (ack returned); post-restart boot_id=3b2dd459... proves restart; lan-b IP reapplied and ping to node1's lan-b gateway succeeded; final cross-node test (node2->node3 ping + blocked telnet) confirmed full topology and policy recovery after all three restarts.
